message:
Dear Customer,

Collateral pledged against your loan {{ doc.loan }} was sold for {{ doc.get_formatted("gross_proceeds") }}.

    {% for item in doc.items %}{% if item.sold_qty %}
  • {{ item.loan_security_name or item.loan_security }}: {{ item.sold_qty }} at {{ item.get_formatted("sale_price") }}
    • {% endif %}{% endfor %}

The proceeds will be applied to your loan, and any amount left over will be refunded to you.

Thank you.
name: Loan Security Sale Notice
subject: Collateral sold on your loan {{ doc.loan }}
